story.summaryZh: FIA世界汽车运动理事会批准了2027年的新赛事结构，制造商冠军赛将被两项新赛事取代：FIA世界拉力锦标赛车队冠军赛和WRC车队冠军赛。
story.originalTitle: Two new championships for the FIA WRC in 2027! 🏆 The FIA World Motor Sport Council has approved a new championship structure for 2027, with the Man...
story.summaryEn:
Two new championships for the FIA WRC in 2027! 🏆
The FIA World Motor Sport Council has approved a new championship structure for 2027, with the Manufacturers’ Championship set to be replaced by two new titles:
The FIA WRC Constructors’ Championship: Constructors must compete in every round of the season to be eligible for the title 🌏
WRC Teams’ Championship: Contested over seven nominated events, including a compulsory overseas round and the season finale 👀
Both championships will be exclusive to the Rally1 category 🔥
#FIA #WRC
detailZh:
2027年FIA世界拉力锦标赛将新增两项冠军！🏆
FIA世界汽车运动理事会已批准2027年的新赛制，制造商锦标赛将被两项新冠军取代：
FIA世界拉力锦标赛车队冠军：车队必须参加每轮比赛才有资格获得该冠军 🌏
WRC车队冠军：在七个指定的赛事中进行争夺，包括一个强制性的海外赛事和赛季决赛 👀
两项冠军都将仅限于Rally1类别 🔥
#FIA #WRC

relatedItems.summaryEn:
Celebrating a major milestone in automotive technology! ⚡🏁
Congratulations to BYD and YANGWANG on the U9 Xtreme achieving a remarkable top speed of 503.17 km/h, becoming the first production car to surpass the 500 km/h barrier.
The FIA is proud to recognise this achievement, highlighting BYD’s continued innovation and contribution to shaping the future of road car technology 👏
#FIA #BYD #YANGWANG #SpeedRecognition
detailZh:
庆祝汽车技术重大里程碑！🏁
祝贺比亚迪和杨王汽车U9 Xtreme车型以503.17 km/h的惊人速度突破500 km/h大关，成为首款超过500 km/h的生产汽车。
The FIA为这一成就感到自豪，并强调比亚迪在塑造道路汽车技术未来方面的持续创新和贡献 👏
